---
title: "Flight path"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

The same glider as [chapter 01](../01-duration-glider/index.qmd), flown rather
than trimmed: the flight is integrated from release, so neither the launch nor
the glide is assumed.

Two models, because no single one does both jobs:

- **Rigid body, marched** — RK4. Shows the launch transient, which is what makes
  this glider loop. Numeric, so no gradients.
- **Point mass, collocated** — trimmed at every node, differentiable, no
  surrogate. Cannot loop.
- **Rigid-body collocation is infeasible here**: a tumbling flight is
  chaotically sensitive.
- **Left out:** roll, yaw, unsteady aerodynamics, the hand itself.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Specified

Asked of the user, 2026-09-04:

1. Launch angle free, chosen to maximise time aloft.
2. Report an unsteady result rather than constraining it away.
3. Same aircraft as chapter 01, unchanged.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Assumed

1. Released along its own axis, at zero incidence.
2. Aero is quasi-steady at every instant.
3. Coefficients hold past stall, where they are extrapolated.
:::
